process: Raster concepts followed by hand-redrawn SVG paths; application renders the true SVG assets.

prompts.logo:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: Daily+ habit-tracking mobile app icon design master, square 1024px.
Primary request: Refine an existing simple D+ identity into an elegant, memorable mark for a calm offline daily health habits app. Create a thick, friendly forest-green lowercase d silhouette with a softly leaf-shaped rounded bowl and a separate small warm-lime plus at the upper right. The inner counter is cream, giving the shape a sense of a small new leaf unfurling. Extremely simple smooth curves, geometric and balanced, recognizable at 24px.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed opaque warm ivory #F6F7F2 square background, absolutely no rounded outer-corner mask, no outer border.
Style/medium: Crisp flat vector-friendly editorial brand design, modest organic character, premium gentle productivity app.
Composition/framing: Single centered standalone mark, occupies about 52 percent of square, generous empty margins; no text except the abstract d and plus mark, no device or UI mockup, no collection of alternatives.
Color palette: forest #39765C, pale sage #DDE9DC, lime #B8CC82, ivory #F6F7F2.
Constraints: limit to 3 flat solid fills; smooth clean silhouette; no gradients, shadows, 3D, grain, gloss, watermark, or thin details. This will be redrawn as real SVG paths.
prompts.growth: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one production illustration for the Daily+ healthy daily habits mobile app, to be redrawn as editable SVG. Landscape 3:2 composition with transparent background. Contemporary flat editorial vector art, welcoming organic curves, crisp filled shapes, a few fine forest-green strokes, lots of negative space, no text, no letters, no border, no UI, no mockup, no gradient, no grain, no shadows. Restrained palette forest #39765C, sage #C8DBC0, lime #B8CC82, warm cream #F6F7F2, muted peach #E8B594. Artwork fits within 80 percent of the canvas, centered. This is the same calm botanical visual identity as the Daily+ leaf-shaped d plus logo. Subject: A small sprout with three generous round leaves growing in a soft cream ceramic pot with a green rounded plus on its front, a pale sage irregular oval behind it, one small warm peach sun on the upper right, a droplet floating at left. The pot sits on two thin curved ground lines. Quiet optimism, a new daily beginning. Keep distinct silhouettes and no tiny detailing.
